info.title: Universal Chat Service
info.description: Реализованы Phase 0–6 и blacklist 7.1: Project-admin CRUD, versioned enable/disable, audited reject policy и единый transactional content gate для REST/WS/internal sends, IMAGE captions, edits и forwards. Redis limits fail closed; CORS — exact allowlist; responses содержат X-Request-ID, no-store, nosniff.

post.summary: Validate and upload a private image
post.description: Accepts exactly one multipart field named file. Active human/bot actor required; no conversation membership is needed until attachment. Checks allow_images and effective min(project.max_upload_size, GLOBAL_MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE) before and immediately before persistence. Filename is metadata only. Client MIME, extension, magic bytes, exact container end, full JPEG/PNG/WebP decode, dimensions <=8192 and pixels <=16M must agree. Object bytes are never stored in PostgreSQL. A storage failure leaves an explicit uploading lifecycle row for reconciliation.

Bans prohibit writes. SYSTEM is internal only. SENT follows PostgreSQL commit, independently of Kafka availability. Idempotency is scoped to Project/sender/client_message_id for 365 days: same command returns 200; changed content, metadata, reply/forward source or conversation returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Retained deleted/expired content with a live receipt returns 200 with the same message identity and redacted tombstone; after dedup expiry the ID may create a new message. Reply requires allow_reply and a live same-conversation target. Forward requires allow_forward, readable live TEXT source in the same Project and writable target; it creates a separately encrypted content/author snapshot, copies no metadata or relations, and never exposes source conversation. Matching retries recheck their feature flag but do not require the source to remain live.

external_user_id.description: Строковое представление подтверждённого числового ID пользователя Auth; не имя и не email.

project_id.description: Project из серверной конфигурации AUTH_PROJECT_ID (в remote); клиент его не выбирает.

roles.description: Текущая роль из chat.users.role: user либо admin. Изменение оператором действует со следующего запроса с прежним JWT. Не копируется из Auth/JWT. Moderator — будущая роль membership, не Project role.

display_name.description: No leading/trailing whitespace or control characters.

avatar_url.description: Empty to clear; otherwise HTTPS URL without userinfo.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; null at end. Pass unchanged as cursor.

word.description: One Unicode letter/digit token; NFC and case-folding are server-side.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor; null at end. Pass unchanged as cursor.

last_message_id.description: Reference only; message may already be expired.

Conversation.description: Private conversation in the current Project. Own membership checkpoints are private. Message and event sequences are independent; a nullable last_message_id never bypasses expiration checks.

member_ids.description: Только другие существующие пользователи этого Project; creator добавляется автоматически. Для DIRECT ровно один; GROUP/CHANNEL допускают пустой список.

title.description: Без крайних пробелов/control chars. DIRECT только пустое значение.

avatar_url.description: Пусто или HTTPS URL без userinfo, не скачивается сервером. DIRECT только пусто.

ConversationPatch.description: GROUP/CHANNEL moderator; требуется title или avatar_url, null запрещён. Пустая строка очищает значение, type/creator/members неизменяемы.

MemberPatch.description: Хотя бы role/banned/muted. Muted только self; role/ban только moderator GROUP/CHANNEL. DIRECT поддерживает лишь self-mute. Null запрещён. Последнего активного moderator нельзя снять/забанить.

text.description: Nonblank UTF-8 text, at most 16384 bytes and 2048 distinct indexed words.

caption.description: Optional IMAGE caption; absent/empty is allowed.

file.description: Exactly one JPEG, PNG or WebP file part.

expires_at.description: Unattached upload cleanup deadline; attachment in Phase 6.2 changes lifecycle.

MessageSend.description: Exactly one command shape. Forward cannot include type, content, metadata or reply_to_message_id, even as empty/null fields.

metadata.description: Encrypted JSON object, at most 8192 encoded bytes; omitted means {}.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional live message in the same conversation. Requires allow_reply. Omit when unused; null is rejected.

attachment_ids.description: One own ready, unexpired upload; consumed atomically with message/outbox.

forwarded_from_message_id.description: Readable live TEXT or IMAGE message in the same Project; source and target conversations may differ.

display_name.description: Historical safe display name captured when the first forward is created.

message_id.description: Immediate source message. It remains attribution data after source purge.

MessageForward.description: Encrypted independent provenance snapshot. Source conversation is intentionally absent.

reactions.description: Current counts sorted by canonical emoji; empty for deleted/expired messages. No unbounded user list.

attachments.description: Exactly one item for active IMAGE; empty for TEXT/SYSTEM and tombstones. Storage keys and URLs are excluded.

Message.description: Authorized current state. Active rows have content; empty metadata may be omitted. Deleted/expired retained rows are tombstones with no content, metadata, reply or forward. Replace the whole client DTO, never merge an omitted body into an older version. Forward content and original_sender are immutable snapshots independent of source lifecycle; source conversation is never returned. Original target sender/sequence/TTL remain stable. Reactions and pin share resource_version; relation mutations also invalidate stale edit versions. Terminal messages have reactions=[] and no pin. Features gate writes; existing relation state remains readable.

status.description: SENT acknowledges the original committed send. The nested message is current state and may already be edited, deleted or expired.

next_cursor.description: Exclusive sequence for the next before_sequence or after_sequence request.

payload.description: Stored events contain references only. Authorized replay hydrates message.created/updated/deleted, reaction.created/deleted and message.pinned/unpinned with the whole current Message, including reactions/pin. Apply current resource_version; never apply historical relation deltas. Deleted/expired resources have no relations. Hidden peer receipts become sync.advance.

pins.description: All live pinned message IDs ordered by message sequence, including pins outside the last 50 messages. Replace this collection at snapshot_event_sequence.

MessageReply.description: Same-conversation reference. Resolve through GET /api/v1/messages/{id}; no original content snapshot is copied.

expected_version.description: Current resource_version; stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

description.description: Encrypted at rest; visible only to the reporter and Project admins.

RequestID.name: X-Request-ID
RequestID.description: Correlation ID, не ключ авторизации или идемпотентности. Принимается UUID canonical layout, версии 1–8, RFC variant 8/9/a/b; uppercase нормализуется в lowercase. При другом значении, nil/max UUID или отсутствии заголовка генерируется UUID v4 без ошибки валидации.

BearerAuth.description: Access JWT текущего Auth (HS256 с sid/jti). Введите только JWT без Bearer. Chat отправляет точный токен на настроенный Auth GET /api/v1/users/me при каждом запросе, проверяя активную сессию без кеша. Logout/refresh выполняются в Auth; refresh tokens не принимаются Chat. Project задаётся сервером, user/admin берутся только из Chat DB. Не передавайте токен в URL. Auth 401/403 -> Chat 401; сбой Auth -> Chat 503. dev-rsa — отдельный offline development/test режим, роли JWT также игнорируются.
